overview: PromptVault is a dark, premium AI prompt inspiration gallery. Browse cinematic AI images with their full prompts in a real Pinterest-style masonry layout, copy prompts instantly with a toast notification, save favorites, and track your copy history. Admins can add, edit, and delete prompts via a protected dashboard.
features: Pinterest-style masonry grid with natural image heights
Click any image to open a centered full-screen modal with large image and full prompt
Copy Prompt button with instant Copied! toast notification
Search bar + filter tabs (All, Trending, Popular, New)
Favorites and copy history saved in browser storage
Dark modern UI with neon glow and OKLCH color system
